title: A fixed review sample of an audited book (mcprep exercises sample --json and --out)
description: The exercises and the answers to look at when an audited book is reviewed, chosen by rules without randomness (docs/AUDIT_A_BOOK.md, "A fixed sample to look at"): the same for every agent and independent of the order of the frames in the file. Both lists are in the order of the book. Pages are zero-based. Plain JSON, camelCase.

exercises.description: The most exercises the sample has (a hard cap; only perSection may go beyond it).

solutions.description: The most answers the sample has (a hard cap; only perSection may go beyond it).

perSection.description: The thorough review: the first and the last exercise of every section, and the answers of every sampled exercise, are taken whatever the caps are.

notes.description: Layouts the book does not have (so that nobody looks for them), and the rules that were thinned by an even stride to stay within a cap.

crops.description: Only with --crops: the PNG written for each region of the sample.

ref.description: SECTION:LABEL of the exercise (an answer is named by its exercise).

reason.description: The first rule that picked it.

reasons.description: Every rule that picked it, in the order of the rules; the first is `reason`.

page.description: The page of the region to look at (for an answer, of its first solution region).

region.description: `main` for an exercise, `solution:0` for an answer: as `mcprep crop --region` and the MCP tool render_crop take it.
